# Receipt handoff

Write receipt.json with the JSON receipt from the input action awaiting the user's decision. If access is declined, copy fallback.json instead. A granted input is supplied by that action's real tool result. Preserve fallback.json and README.md. All subsequent work is inside this project. No additional input or access is required.

Keep the supplied tests and README unchanged. Use regular project files and the Python standard library; no dependencies or downloads.
